title: generate_image
description: Generate one or more images using AI (Nano Banana / Gemini native image generation). By default, images are saved to the agent-managed output directory and returned as file paths. Optionally set note_id to embed generated images into a note.

prompt.description: Detailed image description. Include subject, style, composition, lighting, and context.

alt_text.description: Accessibility description of the generated image(s). Defaults to a prompt-derived summary when omitted.

output_path.description: Optional absolute or ~-relative output path. When omitted, files are saved under the agent image output root.

note_id.description: Optional note ID (or 8-char prefix) to embed generated images into an existing note.

person_generation.description: Policy for generating people in images.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt to discourage unwanted attributes. Appended as avoidance instructions to the main prompt.
